------------
 Coram : M. S. Karnik, J.
 Date : February 8, 2023.

Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned App.
2.

This is an application for pre-arrest bail in respect of First Information Report (Fir)
No.837/2022 registered with the Pelhar Police Station, Nallasopara, Vasai, District-Thane under
Sections 328 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (hereafter "the Ipc", for short) read with Sections
26(2), 4, 30(2)(a) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.
3.  The contraband 'gutkha' and 'paan-masala' was seized from the co-accused nos.1 and 2.
The co-accused no.3 was Diksha Rane 902.

4. My attention is invited to the order dated February 6,2023 passed by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Parvez Ansari & anr. vs. The State of Maharashtra 1.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: I am informed that the issue as regards the interpretation of Section 328 of the IPC is pending before the Hon'ble Supreme Court.
5. Learned APP submitted that there are twenty-three criminal antecedents of the similar nature reported against the applicant where the applicant is a wanted accused.
6. The applicant to co-operate with the investigation.
Let the applicant to report to the investigating officer on 11 th and 12th February, 2023, between 11.00 a.m. and 1.00 p.m. and thereafter, as and when called.
